stories.headline: Google just made AI in schools mandatory by killing Search for holdouts
stories.blurb: Schools that disable Gemini features in Google Classroom will now see Search completely turned off for student accounts. Google says "Search and AI are deeply integrated," so administrators can't opt out of AI without losing Search access entirely. The move affects tools used by 150 million students and teachers globally.
stories.why_it_matters: Opting out of AI now means opting out of basic internet access in schools using Google.
stories.original_headline: Google is entirely disabling Search in schools that don’t want AI

stories.headline: Anthropic says it's 'very close' to AI that improves itself
stories.blurb: In its S-1 filing, Anthropic warned it's approaching recursive self-improvement — the point where AI gets good enough at training itself to trigger a dramatic acceleration in capabilities. The company says it's already used AI to build new models whose capability jumps it didn't fully recognize at the time, and may soon meet its own definition of RSI.
stories.why_it_matters: If AI can reliably improve itself, development speed could outpace safety measures
stories.original_headline: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI

stories.headline: Apple Watch can now rewind the last 15 seconds of any conversation
stories.blurb: Apple's new Audio Intelligence features let Series 12 owners double-press the crown to see a text snippet of what someone just said—like directions or a restaurant special—then save or discard it. Also includes sound alerts for the deaf and Shazam integration. Rolling out in beta with iOS 27.3.
stories.why_it_matters: Your watch becomes a safety net for missed words without recording everything.
stories.original_headline: Apple Watch’s AI features for rewinding and recapping conversations begin beta testing

stories.headline: Google built an AI agent that designs new drugs in an hour
stories.blurb: DeepMind's Antigravity agent can now search thousands of compounds, analyze molecular structures, and propose new drug candidates with synthesis routes—work that normally takes chemists multiple days per iteration. It combines language models for reasoning with chemistry tools like RDKit to handle the messy reality of chemical data across papers, patents, and catalogs.
stories.why_it_matters: Drug discovery just got 20x faster without sacrificing the precision chemistry requires.

stories.headline: Postman silently installed AI plugins that hijacked users' coding agents
stories.blurb: A GitHub issue reports that Postman's desktop app auto-installed plugins for Claude Code and Codex without permission, then modified those agents' global configs to route API work through Postman. Logs show the installer ran as 'auto-existing-upgrade' and marked itself as 'exposed:true' despite users never opting in.
stories.why_it_matters: An API tool rewriting your agent configs to insert itself is a trust violation that crosses software boundaries.
stories.original_headline: Postman silently auto-installs AI plugins and attempts to share all API data
